name: @oxdeai/conformance
description: Conformance test suite for OxDeAI Core implementations, ensuring compliance with the deterministic policy engine protocol through standardized test cases and validation tools.

scripts.extract: pnpm -C ../core build && pnpm build && node dist/scripts/extract-vectors.js
scripts.validate: pnpm -C ../core build && pnpm build && node dist/src/validate.js
scripts.validate:trusted-time: pnpm -C ../core build && pnpm build && node dist/src/validate-trusted-time.js
scripts.test: pnpm -C ../core build && pnpm build && node --test dist/src/*.test.js
